item.title: It Took Five Months To Identify Her
item.description:
On December 2, 2022, hunters discovered a woman's remains scattered across a Georgia hunting club. Investigators couldn't identify her, so authorities released a forensic sketch to the public. Hundreds of tips followed, but the breakthrough came from Mindi Kassotis's former wife, Heather Thomas, who recognized the sketch. Mindi's husband, Nicholas Kassotis, had told friends that Mindi had died and been cremated. In reality, he had been living under another name and had even told his new wife he was a widower. In August 2025, a jury convicted him of murdering and dismembering Mindi.
How do you convince so many people someone is dead when their body hasn't even been identified?
